faq.question: Can I book just the cruise and add flights later?
faq.answer: Yes. We can lock in a cruise cabin now and add air, hotel, and transfers whenever your plans are firm — though bundling early typically saves 10–20% versus booking separately.

faq.question: Do you handle flights from smaller cities?
faq.answer: Yes. We book from virtually any U.S. or Canadian departure airport, including regional airports, and we can arrange overnight connections to guarantee you arrive a day early.

faq.question: What happens if my flight is delayed and I miss the ship?
faq.answer: Because we bundle air with the cruise line, protected-airfare programs can rebook you to the next port at little or no cost. We also recommend arriving a day early — and we price that hotel night into your bundle.

faq.question: How far in advance should I book?
faq.answer: For cruises, 6–12 months ahead gets the best cabin selection and group rates. Caribbean and Alaska peak-season sailings often sell out of bundled air allocations 4–6 months out.
